subject.title: fix: keep keyless web search on secrets fast path

question: Should OpenClaw add and support a generic plugin-facing declaration for keyless web-search fast-path eligibility, or should core continue treating plugin-owned web-search configuration as requiring full secrets preparation?
rationale: This is a durable ownership and compatibility choice: the current patch makes an otherwise opaque nested plugin configuration field a core security decision, and the repository policy requires a generic seam for that boundary.

options.title: Define a generic plugin capability
options.body: Add an owner-approved documented SDK or manifest declaration for selected keyless web-search eligibility and make the fast path consume only that contract.

options.title: Keep the current conservative behavior
options.body: Reject this exception and continue using the full resolver whenever plugin-owned web-search configuration is present.

recommendation.title: Define a generic plugin capability
recommendation.body: Add an owner-approved documented SDK or manifest declaration for selected keyless web-search eligibility and make the fast path consume only that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current narrowing logic and are the clearest available routing candidate from the supplied feature history.
